title: Reply Mode Walkthrough
subtitle: Create useful replies without sounding generic

scenes.caption: Open Reply Mode and show the reply workflow.
scenes.narration: Reply Mode is for daily engagement. Paste the post you want to respond to, generate options, then pick the reply that adds something specific.

scenes.caption: Pick the strongest response.
scenes.narration: The finished action is simple. Pick the strongest reply, edit if needed, and use it as today's engagement move.
